hooks.command: echo "[$(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Session started | Model: ${CLAUDE_MODEL:-sonnet} | Effort: ${CLAUDE_EFFORT_LEVEL:-medium} | Thinking: ${CLAUDE_THINKING:-off} | Fast: ${CLAUDE_FAST_MODE:-off}" >> ~/.claude/projects/portfolio-sessions.log 2>/dev/null || true

grep -qE '(speckit-specify|speckit-plan|speckit-tasks|/plan )' <<< "$CLAUDE_PROMPT" && echo '{"systemMessage": "💡 Tip: This planning task is best handled by Opus. Switch with /model opus, then run your command."}' || true
echo '{"systemMessage": "⚡ Quick lookup task detected. Consider /model haiku for faster, cheaper responses on simple reads."}' || true

statusLine.command: jq -r '"🤖 Model: \(.model // "sonnet") | Effort: \(.effortLevel // "medium")\(.alwaysThinkingEnabled and " | 🧠 Thinking" or "")\(.fastMode and " | ⚡ Fast" or "")"' 2>/dev/null || echo '🤖 Model: sonnet | Effort: medium'
